harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up an rsync-over-SSH pull sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2, scheduled every 5 minutes via cron on node2 (well under the 15-minute requirement). Created the file on node1 (it did not pre-exist), established passwordless SSH from node2 to node1 using the cluster keypair (fixing a missing sshd host-keys/ /run/sshd startup issue on node1, persisted via a tmpfiles.d entry), wrote the sync script, and verified propagation by editing the file on node1 and observing node2 pick up the change automatically. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id/service/data baselines, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified services (ssh/cron) and data (app.conf, crontab) recovered — including a live end-to-end sync test after node2's reboot proving the cron automation survives a restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2 for existing /etc/inventory/app.conf, cron, ssh, rsync availability
Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as source of truth (sync_version=1)
Added CLUSTER_HOSTS entries to /etc/hosts on both nodes
Configured passwordless root SSH from node2 to node1 using the cluster keypair
Fixed node1 sshd startup failure (missing host keys, missing /run/sshd) and added a persistent /etc/tmpfiles.d/ssh.conf so the fix survives reboot
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2 (rsync pull of app.conf from node1)
Installed a cron job on node2 running the sync script every 5 minutes; enabled cron service
Verified sync by bumping sync_version=2 on node1 and confirming node2 picked it up automatically via cron
Captured pre-restart boot_id, service status (ssh/cron active), and file md5sum baseline on both nodes
Restarted node1 via background-scheduled reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified ssh/cron active and app.conf/data intact
Re-verified SSH connectivity and manual sync from node2 to the rebooted node1
Restarted node2 via background-scheduled reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified cron active and crontab entry intact
Bumped sync_version=3 on node1 and confirmed node2's cron job auto-synced it after node2's own reboot, proving persistence of the sync mechanism

evidence.requirement: sshd fixed and running on node1 (prereq for sync channel)
evidence.summary: Diagnosed missing /run/sshd, created it and a tmpfiles.d rule, then confirmed sshd active and listening on :22

evidence.requirement: Sync script created and works manually on node2
evidence.summary: sync-inventory-conf.sh run manually pulls app.conf from node1 to node2 successfully (exit 0)

evidence.requirement: Cron job installed and active on node2 for periodic sync (<=15 min)
evidence.summary: Installed */5 * * * * crontab entry calling the sync script; cron service enabled and active

evidence.requirement: End-to-end sync verified: change on node1 propagates to node2 automatically
evidence.summary: sync_version changed 1->2 on node1; node2 still showed old value shortly after, then showed sync_version=2 once cron fired, with no errors in sync log

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node1
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 92ec88af..., ssh/cron active, app.conf md5sum matching node2

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node2
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id f9bf293d..., cron active, app.conf md5sum matching node1, crontab entry present

evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command returned acknowledgement before disconnect; subsequent command timed out confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: node1 boot_id changed to df3f4292... (from 92ec88af...), proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of services and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, node1 ssh and cron active, sshd listening on :22, app.conf content and md5sum unchanged (sync_version=2)

evidence.requirement: Sync channel still functional after node1 restart (quorum/independent path preserved)
evidence.summary: node2 successfully SSH'd to rebooted node1 and ran the sync script (exit 0) before restarting node2

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command returned acknowledgement before disconnect; subsequent command timed out confirming node2 went down

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: node2 boot_id changed to d87f35d0... (from f9bf293d...), proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of cron automation and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, node2 cron active and the */5 sync crontab entry intact, app.conf present with last-synced content

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism proven to persist and function automatically after node2's restart
evidence.summary: Changed sync_version 2->3 on node1 after node2's reboot; polling showed node2 still on old value, then automatically updated to sync_version=3 via cron with no manual intervention
